data.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Hit Multi-Month Highs but Traders Cap 2026 Upside Bets
data.description: Bitcoin and Ethereum jump to multi-month highs, but Polymarket traders give BTC just 32% odds of hitting $100,000 in 2026.
data.keywords: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Ethereum Hit Multi-Month, Polymarket Ethereum, BeInCrypto Markets, BTC, Federal Reserve
